en.title: GraphDB MCP Server
en.summary: Open-source Model Context Protocol connector that gives LLM clients controlled, read-only access to GraphDB repositories and SPARQL.
en.challenge: LLM clients needed a narrow, read-only way to inspect approved knowledge graphs and execute SPARQL without receiving broad database credentials or write access.
contribution: Implemented an MCP server that exposes GraphDB repository discovery and read-only SPARQL operations as model tools.
Defined the protocol boundary between conversational clients and the semantic database.
Published the connector and its usage documentation as an open-source repository.
technical: JavaScript MCP server accepts structured tool requests from compatible LLM clients.
GraphDB HTTP endpoints execute repository discovery and read-only SPARQL queries.
Responses are normalized for conversational use while the server preserves a constrained access surface.

architecture.label: LLM client
architecture.detail: An MCP-compatible assistant requests graph discovery or a bounded query.

architecture.label: MCP server
architecture.detail: Tool schemas validate requests and enforce the read-only connector boundary.

architecture.label: GraphDB
architecture.detail: Repository APIs and SPARQL endpoints evaluate approved semantic queries.

architecture.label: Grounded result
architecture.detail: Normalized graph results return to the model for explanation or downstream reasoning.

outcomes: Shows practical integration of the Model Context Protocol with enterprise semantic infrastructure.
Reduces the privilege surface by focusing the public connector on read-only graph access.
Reuses knowledge-graph experience from sustainability and R&D systems in a portable developer tool.

zh.title: GraphDB MCP 伺服器
zh.summary: 開源 Model Context Protocol 連接器，讓 LLM 用戶端能以受控唯讀方式存取 GraphDB 儲存庫與 SPARQL。
zh.role: 協定與知識圖譜工程師
zh.challenge: LLM 用戶端需要一種範圍明確且唯讀的方式，檢視經核准的知識圖譜並執行 SPARQL，同時避免取得廣泛資料庫憑證或寫入權限。
contribution: 實作 MCP 伺服器，將 GraphDB 儲存庫探索與唯讀 SPARQL 操作公開為模型工具。
定義對話式用戶端與語意資料庫之間的協定邊界。
將連接器與使用文件發布為開源儲存庫。
technical: JavaScript MCP 伺服器接收相容 LLM 用戶端傳入的結構化工具請求。
GraphDB HTTP 端點執行儲存庫探索與唯讀 SPARQL 查詢。
回傳結果經標準化以供對話使用，同時維持受限的伺服器存取範圍。

architecture.label: LLM 用戶端
architecture.detail: 相容 MCP 的助理要求探索圖譜或執行範圍受限的查詢。

architecture.label: MCP 伺服器
architecture.detail: 工具結構驗證請求，並強制執行唯讀連接器邊界。

architecture.label: GraphDB
architecture.detail: 儲存庫 API 與 SPARQL 端點執行經核准的語意查詢。

architecture.label: 具依據的結果
architecture.detail: 標準化圖譜結果回傳模型，用於說明或後續推理。

outcomes: 展示 Model Context Protocol 與企業語意基礎設施的實際整合。
將公開連接器聚焦於唯讀圖譜存取，降低權限暴露範圍。
把永續與研發系統的知識圖譜經驗轉化為可攜式開發工具。
